description: A space-themed sticker activity sheet lies open on a bed, with a white astronaut silhouette on the left page and a numbered sticker section on the right. The left hand moves in from the left to pinch and lift a small sticker piece near the astronaut’s chest area, then shifts rightward as the right hand comes in from the right; both hands briefly hold the same small piece as it’s adjusted and pressed down onto a target spot on the right-side sticker area, and then the fingers release.
